tool_schemas.name: get_epub_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Extracts and returns formatted metadata from the EPUB at the provided epub_path (e.g., title/author/publisher/identifiers when present). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if epub_path is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the target is not a readable EPUB, and INTERNAL_ERROR if metadata extraction fails unexpectedly.

epub_path.description: Path to the EPUB file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

tool_schemas.name: read_epub_page_range
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns a formatted string containing normalized text for pages from start_page through end_page (inclusive) from the EPUB at epub_path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if epub_path is missing/empty, if start_page/end_page are not integers, or if start_page > end_page; raises NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE if any requested page index is outside the document’s available page range, and UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file is not a readable EPUB.

epub_path.description: Path to the EPUB file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

tool_schemas.name: read_epub_pages
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns a formatted string containing normalized text for the specified list of page numbers from the EPUB at epub_path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if epub_path is missing/empty, if pages is empty or contains non-integers/duplicates, or if page numbers are not valid positive indexes; raises NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE if any requested page is outside the document’s available page range, and UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file is not a readable EPUB.

epub_path.description: Path to the EPUB file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

pages.description: List of page numbers to read.

tool_schemas.name: get_pdf_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Extracts and returns formatted metadata from the PDF at the provided pdf_path (e.g., title/author/producer/creation dates when present). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pdf_path is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the target is not a readable PDF, and INTERNAL_ERROR if metadata extraction fails unexpectedly.

pdf_path.description: Path to the PDF file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

tool_schemas.name: read_pdf_page_range
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns a formatted string containing extracted text for pages from start_page through end_page (inclusive) from the PDF at pdf_path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pdf_path is missing/empty, if start_page/end_page are not integers, or if start_page > end_page; raises NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE if any requested page index is outside the document’s available page range, and UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file is not a readable PDF.

pdf_path.description: Path to the PDF file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

tool_schemas.name: read_pdf_pages
tool_schemas.description: Reads and returns a formatted string containing extracted text for the specified list of page numbers from the PDF at pdf_path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pdf_path is missing/empty, if pages is empty or contains non-integers/duplicates, or if page numbers are not valid positive indexes; raises NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE if any requested page is outside the document’s available page range, and UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file is not a readable PDF.

pdf_path.description: Path to the PDF file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

pages.description: List of page numbers to read.

tool_schemas.name: search_pdf
tool_schemas.description: Searches the PDF at pdf_path for the provided terms (a single string or comma-separated terms) and returns formatted results indicating which pages contain matches. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if pdf_path or terms is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file is not a readable PDF, and INTERNAL_ERROR if text extraction/search processing fails unexpectedly.

pdf_path.description: Path to the PDF file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

terms.description: Search term(s) as a single string; multiple terms may be provided as a comma-separated string.

tool_schemas.name: search_epub
tool_schemas.description: Searches the EPUB at epub_path for the provided terms (a single string or comma-separated terms) and returns formatted results indicating which pages contain matches. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if epub_path or terms is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the path cannot be resolved or the file is not accessible. Raises UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE if the file is not a readable EPUB, and INTERNAL_ERROR if text extraction/search processing fails unexpectedly.

epub_path.description: Path to the EPUB file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

terms.description: Search term(s) as a single string; multiple terms may be provided as a comma-separated string.

tool_schemas.name: list_documents
tool_schemas.description: Lists documents with optional filtering by doc_type and status. Returns a paginated set of document records ordered by updated_at desc. Refuses INVALID_PAGE if pagination is invalid, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values.

source_path_hash.description: Filter by exact source_path_hash (hex string) to de-duplicate registrations.

q.description: Case-insensitive contains match across filename/title/author when present.

tool_schemas.name: get_document
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single document by id and returns its current persisted fields (including ingest status and any ingest_error). Raises NOT_FOUND if the document id does not exist, and VALIDATION_ERROR if id is missing or malformed.

tool_schemas.name: create_document
tool_schemas.description: Registers a document for ingestion from a local/remote source path. Returns the created document record in status='registered' (or the existing record if the same (doc_type, source_path_hash) already exists). Refuses CONFLICT if the path maps to a different existing document for the same type, and VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields.

source_path.description: Path to the document file (local filesystem path or resolvable path string).

filename.description: Optional display filename to store alongside the document.

title.description: Optional title override to store at registration time.

author.description: Optional author override to store at registration time.

language.description: Optional language tag (e.g., 'en', 'en-US') to store at registration time.

tool_schemas.name: update_document
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable document fields and/or drives supported lifecycle transitions for a document. Returns the updated document record. Refuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION if the requested status change is not allowed, and refuses updates on status='deleted' except no-ops.

status.description: Optional new lifecycle status. Transitions must follow the declared lifecycle (e.g., registered->ingesting, ingesting->ready/error, error->ingesting, any->deleted where allowed).

ingest_error.description: Optional ingest error message to store when moving to status='error'.

tool_schemas.name: ingest_document
tool_schemas.description: Starts or restarts ingestion for a document by id (metadata extraction and page/chapter text normalization). Returns the document record after moving it to status='ingesting' (or refuses if transition is not permitted). Refuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION if the document cannot enter 'ingesting', and NOT_FOUND if id does not exist.

force.description: If true, allows re-ingestion from status='ready' by first transitioning to 'error' then to 'ingesting' when permitted by policy; otherwise only allowed from 'registered' or 'error'.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this API key. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate requests; when provided here it must match the credential used for other endpoints.

metadata.name: Document Reader
metadata.description: This backend stores ingested document files (PDF/EPUB), their extracted metadata, and normalized page/chapter text to support reading page ranges and full-text search. Core workflows are: register/import a document from a local/remote path, extract metadata and paginated text, then serve read and se
